eyebrow: Two layers of resilience, not one

steps.label: Built-in local HA
steps.sub: automatic, included -- protects against a zone/node failure

steps.label: Geo-replication + failover group
steps.sub: explicit, cross-region -- protects against losing a region

steps.label: The failover group listener
steps.sub: the one endpoint every app must use -- never the primary server directly

eyebrow: Standing up the cross-region failover group
code:
az sql server create \
  --name thornridge-sql-server-secondary \
  --resource-group rg-thornridge-sql-prod \
  --location centralus

az sql failover-group create \
  --name thornridge-sql-failover-group \
  --server thornridge-sql-server \
  --partner-server thornridge-sql-server-secondary \
  --add-db PolicyClaimsDB \
  --failover-policy Automatic
caption: Apps connect to the LISTENER -- thornridge-sql-failover-group.database.windows.net -- never the primary server's own hostname.

eyebrow: Targets, and the commitment that comes with them
code:
Local HA (Layer 1):     RTO ~seconds-30s   RPO 0
Regional DR (Layer 2):  RTO target <1hr    RPO <5s

"An HA/DR setup that has never been failed over
is a hypothesis, not a capability."
caption: A real failover drill is already on the plan, once this is built.
